mainEntity.name: Can AI create and sell a digital product for me, or is that mostly hype?

acceptedAnswer.text:
AI can help produce a draft, but it does not automatically create a valuable digital product. You still need a defined audience, a useful promise, accurate material, a coherent structure, quality control, delivery method, and a way to reach potential buyers.

Run My AI Biz covers workflows for research, course outlines, lesson scripts, presentations, videos, sales pages, funnels, and follow-up. Those components must be connected around a real customer problem rather than generated as unrelated content.

Key factors:
- Evidence that the audience wants the topic
- Your expertise or ability to verify the material
- Product format and delivery platform
- Support, updates, and customer feedback

Start by validating the problem and desired outcome. Create an outline, review the claims, produce a small usable section, and gather feedback before building the full product or funnel.

Run My AI Biz offers educational guidance for turning AI-assisted drafts into a considered product rather than presenting generated text as a finished offer.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can assist with research, outlines, lessons, sales copy, funnels, and promotional drafts, but it cannot validate demand or guarantee sales. You still need a real audience problem, accurate content, review, delivery, and customer feedback.
